SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/6TyWPsK18QxpkAZP3-cbTz3xrhsHBDG9

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (44 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

To explore SMB Team's AI solutions for automating law firm operations.

Key Takeaways

Core Goal: Use AI to increase staff capacity and pay raises, avoiding new hires.

Key Pain Point: The manual intake process requires checking 5+ systems for conflicts, creating a major bottleneck.

SMB Team Solutions: Two tiers: AI Workforce Pro (a pre-built AI platform) and Fractional CTO (custom automation builds).

Next Step: A follow-up call with Alison and owner Amber on Tuesday, Aug 12, at 1 PM Pacific to discuss pricing and options.

Topics

Firm Context & AI Goals

Diamond Law: A family law firm in Scottsdale and Chandler, AZ.

Team: 4 attorneys, 1 Legal Paraprofessional (LP), and support staff.

Primary Goal: Use AI to boost staff capacity and enable pay raises, not to reduce headcount.

Current AI Use (Claude):

Email Triage: Summarizes inboxes and identifies action items.

Discovery: Automatically saves client documents to Google Drive.

Drafting: Creates draft emails from minute entries for paralegal review.

Team Adoption Challenge: Staff are hesitant to use AI, preferring familiar manual processes.

Key Automation Needs

Intake & Conflict Checking:

Problem: The manual process requires checking 5+ systems (Clio, Google Drive, spreadsheets) for conflicts, which is slow and stressful.

Need: A single AI tool to automate this multi-system search.

Process Documentation:

Problem: Creating video tutorials for all processes is time-consuming.

Need: AI-generated video explainers (e.g., from a script/screenshots) to standardize training.

Billing & Reporting:

Problem: Ensuring all bills meet strict formatting guidelines (e.g., using client names, not "client").

Need: AI to audit Clio bills for compliance and flag issues for correction.

Need: AI-generated reports on metrics like consult-to-retainer rates for performance reviews.

Document Drafting:

Need: AI to pull data from Clio/intake notes and populate firm-standard Word templates.

SMB Team's Proposed Solutions

1. AI Workforce Pro:

Function: A pre-built AI platform with 50+ skills (5 added monthly) for firm-wide use.

Integration: Connects directly to Clio, Google Drive, and Gmail.

Benefit: Provides a structured entry point to AI for hesitant staff.

2. Fractional CTO Service:

Function: A dedicated "AI nerd" (Fractional CTO) builds custom, automated workflows.

Process: Audits firm processes to identify and automate steps (e.g., 27 of 39 steps in a probate case were automated for one client).

Benefit: Delivers deep, custom automation without requiring staff buy-in.

Skill Customization & Privacy:

Customization: Pre-built skills can be customized, and new skills can be created.

Privacy: Private skills can be built for specific users (e.g., owner Amber) to handle sensitive tasks like performance reviews.

Next Steps

Jacob:

Send a recap email to Alison after the Thursday event.

Confirm if AI-generated video tutorials are feasible.

Alison:

Map out role-specific automation needs, flagging any that require private access.

Alison & Amber:

Attend the follow-up call with Jacob on Tuesday, Aug 12, at 1 PM Pacific to discuss options and pricing.

Action Items

Map AI use cases by role for Jacob; flag private owner skills - WATCH (5 secs)
Fix Amber invite; send correct calendar invite to Alison & Amber for Aug 11 1 pm PT - WATCH (5 secs)
